children: At anime and comic conventions, the artist alley is a section for independent artists to display and sell their work. ScottyCon 2026 featured more than 100 CMU student artists selling original and fan merchandise.
The artist alley was held in Wiegand Gymnasium from 11 AM to 8 PM.
